item.title: Mahiro Standup!
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: NoruBOX
  • 発売日: 2021-06-22
  • スコア: 6.95/10 (9 人評価)
  • 日本語名: マヒロSTANDUP!
  • 英語名: Mahiro Standup!

あらすじ

Women and men alike go at it in the boxing ring!

A sweaty ero boxing visual novel with mixed gender matches and cat-fights where your choices decide the winner, and the ending.

Breasts pop out, body blows cause pleasure, and other slightly fetishistic elements are included.

This is the tale of two of Mahiro’s matches. Your choices decide the winner, and the ending!
